source_name: CobbParcels current countywide parcel service - factual parcel identifier projection only
authority_basis: Official Cobb County ArcGIS organization, Cobb County Tax Assessor/GIS distribution policy, Georgia public-record law, and factual-data copyright distinction

legal_scope.rationale: Cobb County expressly distributes countywide Tax Assessor tabular parcel data at no cost through its GIS distribution channel. Georgia Code 50-18-70 defines public records to include government computer-generated information, data, and data fields and states a strong presumption of public access. The U.S. Copyright Office states that individual facts/data points are not protected by copyright even where a creative database compilation may be. BridgePoint therefore limits this candidate to factual parcel identifiers and does not copy the database arrangement, paid polygon product, imagery, owner fields, valuation fields, legal descriptions, or raw source records. This is an engineering/compliance rationale, not a guarantee against litigation or a substitute for counsel.
legal_scope.important_restriction: This manifest does not self-approve reuse. Production ingestion must fail closed unless the live BridgePoint compliance engine accepts the exact parcel-ID-only projection. Geometry remains disabled unless separately approved under a geometry-specific rights decision.
